impeccable.name: Impeccable
impeccable.capabilitySummary: Its current public package documents 23 commands, 60 deterministic rules, CLI checks for local files and URLs, JSON output for CI, and hooks for major coding agents.

styleseedFocus: StyleSeed focuses on compiling a bounded contract for each artifact, persisting approved project decisions, and binding code, build, pixel, and temporal evidence to the exact source revision.
